name: Archer
blurb: Kites away and fires arrows that get stronger every hit. Ultimate: Arrow Rain.

art.floor: short green grass with a few tiny orange autumn leaves, a uniform repeating texture with no trees and no objects
art.body: a sharp-eyed archer: a perfectly round forest green ball body under a dark green pointed hood that shadows the face, two bright eyes peeking out, a brown leather quiver strap across the front
weapons: a wooden recurve bow standing vertically, the curved limbs bulging to the right, a thin white bowstring on the left side

projectiles.arrow: a wooden arrow with a steel arrowhead pointing right and white feather fletching on the left

art.ultimate_icon: three bold wooden arrows falling diagonally downward side by side
art.ult_circle: a green and gold target reticle circle with leaf patterns and arrow markers pointing inward
art.ult_aura: a swirling green wind tornado aura with flying autumn leaves
art.hit_fx: an arrow impact splinter burst of wood chips and green sparks
